summary: Iteration 3 frontend testing (innerCore landing): sticky header, mobile hamburger menu, min-h-screen sections, and FractalTrees canvas. 34/35 checks passed across desktop (1440px) and mobile (390px). All previous iteration-1 tests still pass.

tests_executed.desktop_nav_links_visible: PASS - nav-what/how/map/privacy + nav-cta all visible on 1440px
tests_executed.mobile_inline_nav_hidden: PASS - nav-what & nav-cta (ghost) hidden on mobile
tests_executed.mobile_menu_open: PASS - all 5 items (m-nav-what/how/map/privacy + mobile-cta) visible after toggle
tests_executed.mobile_menu_link_navigates: PASS - scrollY=2544 after clicking m-nav-map (close handler fires, scroll to section works)

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: FractalTrees.jsx uses ResizeObserver + IntersectionObserver — both properly disconnected in cleanup. Good.
Minor: Nav scroll listener is passive and removed on unmount. Good.
Nit: container-ms padding (1.5rem) gives ample tap area for hamburger on 390px viewport. OK.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (34/35 raw assertions; 1 is a test-selector artifact, not a real bug)
